ticketIds.description: Confirmed reservations: the tickets to cancel. Left out: all valid tickets. Held reservations take no tickets

externalRefundRef.description: Confirmed reservations: the channel's refund, stored on each cancelled ticket

status.description: held past expiresAt reads as expired. An expired reservation can still be confirmed while its places are free

expiresAt.description: While held: when the places are released

extendLimitAt.description: The latest expiresAt that extend can reach

group.description: The buyer's user group (its code), as the connector gave it on reserve

unitPrice.description: Minor units (øre), VAT included, frozen at reserve time

externalSku.description: The channel's product for this line

name.description: Line name for the receipt, e.g. "Adult – Hamlet, Sat 13 Feb 19:30, Main stage"

group.description: The user group's code the line was sold under, frozen at reserve time

signature.description: v1.<base64url HMAC-SHA256>. The signed text's first element names its format (reservation_line.v2, reservation.v2). The key is the SHA-256 of the calling channel key's secret (the part of sk_<id>_<secret> after the second underscore); the signed text is a JSON array of the fields in a fixed order (see the integration guide). Null when the caller is not a channel key

partySize.description: People the ticket admits: the offer's places per unit

anyOf.description: Who cancelled the ticket: the channel (a refund) or staff in the admin

externalRefundRef.description: The channel's refund reference given on cancel

url.description: The ticket page with its QR code; null once cancelled

qr.description: The QR code's payload (a signed admission token); null once cancelled

tickets.description: Once confirmed: one per unit, in line order

anonymisedAt.description: When retention removed the buyer, as for registrations; the lines and references stay
